statement.notes: 1. All values extracted from the primary consolidated income statement on page 471. 2. Scale is millions (€ million). 3. For total_operating_cost, standard practice for an automotive manufacturer includes cost of sales, distribution expenses, administrative expenses, and other operating expenses. Other operating income is not included as it is a separate positive component. 4. Taxes and interest_expenses are reported as positive numbers as per the sign convention (they reduce income). 5. The 'Other operating expenses' line from the primary statement is used; its detailed breakdown from Note 6 is not included in the array to avoid double-counting, as the total is already provided. 6. The 'Other operating income' line is not part of total_operating_cost. 7. The 'Share of the result of equity-accounted investments', 'Interest income', and 'Other financial result' are part of the financial result below operating income and are not included in total_operating_cost.
